categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in automation systems and components, energy-saving safety devices and systems, and smart robotics. It provides integrated sales of automation components, PCBA depaneling machines, smart robots, and energy-saving safety products. The business also includes design and installation services for natural smoke exhaust systems and green wind blinds, targeting industries such as semiconductor, electronics manufacturing, logistics, and smart manufacturing.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies including AI, machine learning, sensing, IoT, cloud computing, and EtherCAT network controllers for automation and robotics. It develops proprietary products like multi-functional intelligent depaneling machines, laser depaneling machines, AMR integration systems, and collaborative robots with AI vision. Production involves integration of motion control cards, servo motors, precision reducers, and automated equipment assembly with a focus on modularization, networking, and smart manufacturing.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include semiconductor manufacturers, electronics information companies, general industrial machinery manufacturers, automotive industry, logistics, retail, healthcare, and service sectors. The company serves end markets such as SMT production lines, smart factories, logistics warehouses, medical institutions, chain hotels, and retail malls. It also targets emerging markets in smart manufacturing, smart logistics, and smart cleaning services.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Taiwan with significant domestic sales growth and exports primarily to Asian markets. It also has subsidiaries and investments in China, including Shanghai and Kunshan, and extends its market reach through distributors in Southeast Asia and other regions. The company maintains a global supplier and customer network, including partnerships with Japanese and European component manufacturers.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company functions as a midstream integrator and manufacturer in the supply chain, providing both proprietary automation equipment and acting as an agent for key upstream component suppliers such as servo motors, reducers, and controllers. It integrates these components into automated systems and robotics solutions for downstream industrial and service applications.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding product lines into smart manufacturing, smart logistics, and smart cleaning services, with a focus on AI and robotics integration. R&D efforts emphasize modular components, autonomous mobile robots (AMR), collaborative robots, AI vision systems, and energy-saving technologies. The company aims to enhance market penetration through innovation, system integration, and developing second-life product lines to address labor shortages and sustainability.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of automation components, equipment, and smart robotics solutions. The company also earns income from system integration services, licensing of intellectual property, and agency sales of third-party branded components. It maintains a diversified revenue base across domestic and export markets with a focus on high-value-added solutions.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with domestic IPC manufacturers in control modules and with global technology giants and startups in the smart robotics sector. It differentiates itself through deep expertise in automation equipment integration, strong R&D capabilities, and a comprehensive product portfolio under its Aurotek and auro｜solutions brands. The company holds a competitive position in Taiwan's automation and robotics market with recognized product quality and innovation awards.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$1.66 billion in 2024, representing a 69.1% increase from the previous year. Net profit after tax grew by 120.1% to about NT$175 million, with earnings per share rising from NT$0.95 to NT$2.11. The company has shown strong financial growth and improved profitability, supported by increased demand in automation and robotics sectors.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers one-stop integrated automation solutions combining proprietary equipment, modular components, and smart robotics tailored to customer needs. It emphasizes high-quality, innovative products with AI and IoT integration to enhance manufacturing efficiency, reduce labor dependency, and support sustainable development. Its strong customer service, technical support, and system integration capabilities create high customer stickiness and competitive advantage.
